label: World Regions
description: A spread of places with a strong sense of somewhere. The library had a whole section for Japan and nothing for Morocco, Mexico, West Africa or the Andes — the same enumeration bias that left out nightlife, applied to the map. Described by what is actually in frame, never as a national stereotype.

items.name: marrakech-medina
items.text: A medina lane in Marrakech, ochre walls close on both sides, a studded cedar door, woven baskets stacked outside and cats asleep in the shade.
items.text_short: ochre Marrakech medina lane with a studded door

items.name: moroccan-riad-courtyard
items.text: A riad courtyard open to the sky, zellij tilework to shoulder height, a still central pool and orange trees in glazed pots.
items.text_short: riad courtyard in zellij tile with a still pool

items.name: mexico-colonial-street
items.text: A colonial Mexican street of saturated painted facades, wrought-iron balconies with bougainvillea over them and cobbles running to a domed church.
items.text_short: painted colonial Mexican street with bougainvillea

items.name: mexico-market-hall
items.text: A Mexican market hall of stacked chiles and cut fruit, hand-lettered price cards, bunting overhead and light dropping through a corrugated roof.
items.text_short: Mexican market hall of stacked chiles and cut fruit

items.name: west-africa-market
items.text: A West African market street of wax-print stalls in stacked colour, enamel bowls balanced high, awnings patched from a dozen fabrics.
items.text_short: West African market street of wax-print stalls

items.name: sahel-adobe-town
items.text: A Sahel town of adobe walls and projecting timber beams, a mud-brick mosque tapering above flat roofs and long shadows across swept ground.
items.text_short: Sahel adobe town with a tapering mud-brick mosque

items.name: andes-highland-village
items.text: An Andes highland village of stone and tin roofs above terraced fields, peaks standing white beyond and llamas grazing the near slope.
items.text_short: Andes village above terraced fields

items.name: andes-salt-flat
items.text: An Andean salt flat to every horizon, a shallow film of water making a perfect mirror of the sky, hexagon crusts showing where it has dried.
items.text_short: Andean salt flat mirroring the whole sky

items.name: kerala-backwater
items.text: A Kerala backwater under coconut palms, a houseboat with a woven roof, still green water and nets slung on bamboo poles.
items.text_short: Kerala backwater with a woven-roof houseboat

items.name: rajasthan-stepwell
items.text: A Rajasthan stepwell descending in symmetrical flights, sandstone landings crossing at every level, cool green water at the bottom.
items.text_short: Rajasthan stepwell descending in symmetrical flights

items.name: seoul-alley
items.text: A Seoul back alley of stacked hangul signage, extraction fans and plastic stools outside a grill house, cables drooping between low roofs.
items.text_short: Seoul back alley of stacked signage and plastic stools

items.name: china-water-town
items.text: A Chinese water town of whitewashed gables and black tile, an arched stone bridge, lanterns strung along a canal and a boat poled slowly under.
items.text_short: Chinese water town, arched bridge and strung lanterns

items.name: istanbul-bazaar
items.text: A vaulted bazaar of hanging lamps in coloured glass, carpets stacked to the ceiling and shafts of light coming down through high openings.
items.text_short: vaulted bazaar of coloured glass lamps and carpets

items.name: nordic-fishing-village
items.text: A Nordic fishing village of red timber houses on stilts over dark water, drying racks on the shore and bare rock rising behind.
items.text_short: red timber Nordic fishing village on stilts

items.name: iceland-black-beach
items.text: An Icelandic black sand beach with basalt columns stepping out of the cliff, spray blowing sideways and sea stacks standing offshore.
items.text_short: Icelandic black sand beach under basalt columns

items.name: brazil-hillside-favela
items.text: A Brazilian hillside neighbourhood of stacked painted houses, staircases threading between them, laundry strung across and the city spread below.
items.text_short: stacked painted hillside houses above a Brazilian city

items.name: eastern-europe-panel-block
items.text: An Eastern European panel block estate, repeating concrete facades with mismatched glazed balconies, birches between the buildings and a beaten path across the grass.
items.text_short: panel block estate with mismatched glazed balconies

items.name: mediterranean-hill-town
items.text: A Mediterranean hill town of lime-washed walls and blue shutters, stepped lanes too narrow for cars and a church bell tower at the top.
items.text_short: lime-washed Mediterranean hill town with stepped lanes

items.name: southeast-asia-night-market
items.text: A Southeast Asian street market strung with bare bulbs, woks going at every second stall, steam rolling out and plastic stools filling the road.
items.text_short: bulb-strung Southeast Asian street market

items.name: outback-roadhouse
items.text: An Australian outback roadhouse on red dirt, a corrugated verandah, fuel pumps bleached by sun and a road running dead straight to the heat shimmer.
items.text_short: outback roadhouse on red dirt, road running straight out
